description: This is a multi-tiered display shelf designed for retail or home use. It features a rustic aesthetic, combining wooden planks for the back panel and shelves with a metal frame. The shelves are angled slightly upwards to prevent items from falling. A prominent red sign is mounted at the top, suitable for branding or product information. The overall construction suggests durability and a focus on showcasing products effectively. The combination of wood and metal provides a sturdy structure, while the design elements evoke a natural and organic feel.
